panels.title: bytes_in per minute by sandbox and policy key

targets.expr: sum by (sandbox, policy) (sum_over_time({service_name="openshell-supervisor"} | ocsf_class_uid="4001" | ocsf_activity_id=~"2|6" | json bytes="traffic.bytes_in", sandbox="container.name", policy="firewall_rule.name" | unwrap bytes [1m]))

panels.title: bytes_out per minute by sandbox and policy key

targets.expr: sum by (sandbox, policy) (sum_over_time({service_name="openshell-supervisor"} | ocsf_class_uid="4001" | ocsf_activity_id=~"2|6" | json bytes="traffic.bytes_out", sandbox="container.name", policy="firewall_rule.name" | unwrap bytes [1m]))

panels.title: bytes (in + out), last 5 min, by sandbox and policy key

targets.expr: sum by (sandbox, policy) (sum_over_time({service_name="openshell-supervisor"} | ocsf_class_uid="4001" | ocsf_activity_id=~"2|6" | json bytes="traffic.bytes", sandbox="container.name", policy="firewall_rule.name" | unwrap bytes [5m]))
